notes: Short summary: target is replace current OpenAI-based runtime with more predictable latency + lower tail-costs during spikes.
Customer quote: 'We need agent assist that never times out at 3pm PST when volume spikes' (Head of Support).
Primary motivators: reliability under spikes, predictable billing for committed seats, tighter VPC controls for PII.
Current stack: Node microservice + OpenAI + vendor X caching layer; using in-house prefix cache but inconsistent hits.
Key requirements:
- Support tool-calls: create ticket, escalate, append internal note (must be auditable).
- Streaming suggestions to agent UI; <200ms preferred for local suggestions, 400ms acceptable for full reply.
- Automatic fallbacks to smaller base models when high latency/cost triggers (routing policy).
- Per-route cost controls (batching/caching) and visibility into token-level costs.
POC specifics:
- Dataset: 15k historical tickets + transcript snippets for 6 major intent categories.
- Evaluation criteria: suggestion accuracy, false-action rate (tool-calling safety), latency P95, cost/unit.
